Date: 2026-10-15 (Thu) | Sunny
Topic: Vacuum activation of 01/02 + recovery and rapid exchange of 03
1. Vacuum activation: Zr-BDC-01 & Zr-BDC-02
Zr-BDC-01: MeOH soak 48 h (3 replacements), filter; briefly air-dry at 60 C -> vacuum activation at 150 C for 12 h.
Pure white powder: 248 mg (ideal defect-free theoretical yield ~278 mg; yield ~89.2%).
Zr-BDC-02: ACTIVATION PROBLEM + REWORK
First: vacuum at 120 C for 4 h -> quick FT-IR.

-> Back to vacuum oven: 150 C for another 8 h (TOTAL 12 h).
-> Repeat FT-IR: 1660 cm^-1 disappears; C-F greatly reduced.
Final off-white powder: 215 mg.

LAB NOTEBOOK P04
Date: 2026-10-16 (Fri) | Partly cloudy
Topic: 03 activation at 180 C + PXRD / SEM / FT-IR comparison
1. Zr-BDC-03: after acetone exchange, vacuum activation at 180 C for 12 h.
Gray-white -> pale beige / darker! Only 162 mg (LOW YIELD).
2. PXRD (Cu K-alpha; 2theta = 3-50 degrees)
Zr-BDC-01: sharp, symmetric peaks at 7.36 degrees (111) and 8.50 degrees (200). FWHM 0.14 degrees; standard fcu UiO-66; no impurity peaks.
Zr-BDC-02: strong 7.36 and 8.50 degree peaks, FWHM 0.18 degrees; main framework retained.
KEY: broad superlattice diffuse hump at 2theta = 4.1-5.8 degrees -> reo defect nanodomains (missing-cluster/linker ordered regions).
Zr-BDC-03: ~7.3 degree peak intensity nearly halved; relative crystallinity ~55% of 01. FWHM 0.42 degrees; raised baseline / partial amorphization.
Weak hump at 30.2 degrees: POSSIBLE tetragonal ZrO2 from local hydrolysis under hot, acidic conditions?
Optional small schematic PXRD sketch, with English labels only, accurate peak ordering.
3. SEM morphology / size
Zr-BDC-01: regular octahedra, sharp edges, 280-320 nm (mean ~300 nm).
Zr-BDC-02: truncated octahedra, slightly rounded / etched surface, 200-240 nm (mean ~220 nm).
Zr-BDC-03: degraded octahedra -> irregular spherical / fragmented aggregates, 450-600 nm; cracks and corrosion pits.
4. FT-IR comparison
No DMF band at 1660 cm^-1 in any sample.
Bridging mu3-OH stretch at 3674 cm^-1: 01 > 02 >> 03.
03: severe dehydroxylation at 180 C -> Zr-O-Zr.

LAB NOTEBOOK P05
Date: 2026-10-17 (Sat) | Sunny
Topic: 77 K N2 sorption (BET / pore sizes) + TGA defect quantification
1. N2 physisorption: ASAP 2460. All samples degassed in situ at 150 C for 4 h.
Zr-BDC-01: Type I; steep rise at P/P0 < 0.05, then plateau; no hysteresis.
BET = 1180 m2/g (Langmuir = 1310 m2/g).
Vtotal = 0.48 cm3/g; Vmicro = 0.44 cm3/g.
NLDFT: 0.85 nm micropore peak; minor 0.60 nm cage-window contribution.
Zr-BDC-02: Type I + IV; higher low-pressure uptake than 01.
Small H4 loop at P/P0 = 0.45-0.85.
BET = 1620 m2/g (+37% vs 01!).
Vtotal = 0.74 cm3/g; Vmicro = 0.51; Vmeso = 0.23 cm3/g.
NLDFT: 0.85 + 1.85 nm bimodal hierarchical pores (1.85 nm defect cages, called mesopores in these notes).
Zr-BDC-03: low-pressure uptake drops; slow high-pressure rise with hysteresis.
BET = 740 m2/g; Vtotal = 0.39 cm3/g; Vmicro = 0.21 cm3/g.
Weak 0.85 nm peak + broad 2.6-3.2 nm disordered pores.
60 eq TFA / 160 C over-etching + 180 C activation -> local micropore collapse.
2. TGA: air; 10 C/min; room temperature to 800 C.
Final ZrO2 residue normalized to 100%; use 450-550 C linker-combustion step. Ideal: 6 BDC linkers per Zr6 cluster.
Zr-BDC-01: Td = 515 C; linker/cluster = 5.70 -> 0.30 missing linkers / Zr6 (nearly ideal).
Zr-BDC-02: Td = 490 C; linker/cluster = 4.62 -> 1.38 missing linkers / Zr6 (many unsaturated Zr4+ Lewis acid sites).
Zr-BDC-03: early loss from 410 C; Td = 435 C.
Apparent missing linkers = 2.35 / Zr6 (poor connectivity / low thermal stability!).
Optional tiny schematic pore-size plot only if space permits: 01 peak at 0.85; 02 peaks at 0.85 and 1.85; 03 weak 0.85 plus broad 2.6-3.2. Label it SCHEMATIC and every curve explicitly. Text takes priority.

LAB NOTEBOOK P06
Date: 2026-10-19 (Mon) | Sunny
Topic: CO2/N2 uptake, Qst, IAST, breakthrough and humid cycling
1. Single-component adsorption (0-1 bar)
WATCH UNITS: Zhang used cm3/g STP for the 298 K CO2 value of Zr-BDC-02; other uptake values are mmol/g.
Zr-BDC-01:
273 K / 1 bar CO2 = 3.10 mmol/g.
298 K / 1 bar CO2 = 1.85 mmol/g; at 0.15 bar = 0.52 mmol/g.
298 K / 1 bar N2 = 0.14 mmol/g.
Zr-BDC-02:
273 K / 1 bar CO2 = 5.18 mmol/g.
298 K / 1 bar CO2 = 76.61 cm3/g (STP).
Red annotation: divide by 22.4 cm3/mmol -> 3.42 mmol/g!
At 15 kPa (= 0.15 bar), CO2 = 1.28 mmol/g (2.46 x 01).
298 K / 1 bar N2 = 0.16 mmol/g.
Zr-BDC-03:
273 K / 1 bar CO2 = 2.45 mmol/g.
298 K / 1 bar CO2 = 1.52 mmol/g; at 0.15 bar = 0.41 mmol/g.
298 K / 1 bar N2 = 0.13 mmol/g.
2. Zero-coverage Qst0: Virial fit to 273 / 298 K isotherms.
IAST: 298 K, 1 bar, CO2:N2 = 15:85.
01: Qst0 = 26.5 kJ/mol; IAST = 28.4.
02: Qst0 = 34.8 kJ/mol; IAST = 54.2 (best; open Zr4+ sites enhance CO2 quadrupole interaction; hierarchical pores aid transport).
03: Qst0 = 29.1 kJ/mol; IAST = 21.0 (some defect affinity remains, but micropore collapse lowers capacity/selectivity).
3. Fixed bed + 5 cycles
298 K; CO2/N2 = 15/85; 20 mL/min; packed mass 0.50 g.
Dry: N2 breakthrough 1.2-1.5 min/g for all samples.
CO2 breakthrough: 02 (41.5 min/g) > 01 (23.0 min/g) > 03 (16.8 min/g).
Regenerate: He purge at 80 C.
Retention after 5 dry cycles: 01 99.1%; 02 98.4%; 03 94.0%.
50% RH, 5 cycles; recheck BET / CO2:
01: 97.8% working-capacity retention; PXRD unchanged.
02: 94.6% retention; competing water at Zr sites. 150 C regeneration fully restores capacity; framework intact.
03: uptake LOSS 38.5% -> only 61.5% retained; BET falls to 430 m2/g! Irreversible Zr-O-C hydrolysis / collapse (2.35 missing linkers per cluster).
